mostWorthwhile.text: Making ATP from glucose was most worthwhile: the inset connected food and oxygen with a form of energy the cell uses, which later helped build protein.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the mitochondria and ribosomes was clear but fairly predictable because their pictures already showed where they belonged.

surprise.text: I didn't know ATP was needed for the protein-building step until the compatibility hint showed it; inspecting then automatically made the protein.

arbitrary.text: The need to pair the ribosome with ATP was not clear to me beforehand, though the result explained its purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting food to both cell energy and protein building made me curious about how the next structures fit together.
